searchText: If anyone is interested in ETH issuance there's a community Telegram group on the topic. Please DM for an invite link 🙂 Why do these private TG groups exist on these topics when this server is precisely designed to be the central place to carry R&D. I kinda understand and have created myself some private channels for small issues like the RLND research but it was mostly not to spam here with topics that may have not been interesting to anyone. But things like issuance are surely interesting to many > private TG groups It's a public TG group, hence why I advertise it here 🙂 Well no, it's gated by a DM to you Same as my RNLC channel Here's a public invite link valid for 10 invitees 🙂 I'm trying to avoid spam bots, that's all https://t.me/+iZ4t-nB0bXMxYTc8 I understand, the argument of spam in this server was used many times before, for example it was a fear to open an ePBS channel (which is a ghost town anyway). I have tried to boycott TG channels for over a year now but failed badly 😅 I don't think the spam bots in this Discord server are anywhere near bad enough to need a tightly controlled limited-access communication channels. Unless you are not talking about spam bots but rather you want to limit the set of people who participate in the conversation to some subset of the population, in which case I don't agree with that strategy.
